descriptions.zh-Hans: 在马拉喀什吃配蔬菜的库斯库斯后画的菜单。勺子旁的小点，记着一次被午饭打断的数数。
descriptions.en: Drawn after couscous with vegetables in Marrakesh. Dots beside the spoon recall a counting project interrupted by lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 马拉喀什蔬菜塔吉锅菜的小菜单。旁边那句没说完的形容，最后等来了一个笑脸。
descriptions.en: A menu from my vegetable tagine in Marrakesh. The unfinished description eventually acquired a small smile.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在马拉喀什马若雷勒花园后留下的便签。先记住蓝与绿，再慢慢想今天看过的植物。
descriptions.en: My note after Jardin Majorelle in Marrakesh. Blue and green came back first; the plants followed in their own time.

names.en: A Sentence Still on Its Way

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在马拉喀什尝塔吉锅菜时写的纸条。味道已经记住，句子还等着我吃完那一口。
descriptions.en: A note from tasting tagine in Marrakesh. The flavor was safely remembered while the sentence waited for one more bite.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在马拉喀什巴伊亚宫和旅人歇脚后写的便签。句子间的空当，记着那一次安静听声音。
descriptions.en: My note after a pause with a traveler at Bahia Palace in Marrakesh. Space between the sentences remembers a little time spent listening.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自己做的马拉喀什花园记忆卡。两小块颜色回想马若雷勒花园里那次慢慢看的时间，不是园方的色票。
descriptions.en: My handmade Marrakesh memory card. Two patches recall time spent looking at Jardin Majorelle, rather than serving as official color samples.
